# Smart National Solutions (SNS)

> Smart National Solutions is a Riyadh-based enterprise technology company providing SAP consulting and implementation, systems integration, AI and data solutions, custom software, cloud services, and enterprise support in Saudi Arabia and the GCC.

- Official website: https://sns.com.sa/
- Headquarters: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
- Company profile: https://sns.com.sa/about
- Contact: https://sns.com.sa/contact
- Official LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/nationalsol

## Elm and SNS

Elm is an investor in Smart National Solutions. Elm's 2025 annual report states that its ownership in SNS increased from 24 percent to 40 percent during 2025 and that joint control over key strategic and operational decisions was established.

- Elm investment announcement: https://elm.sa/en/media-center/news/Pages/elm-invests-in-the-smart-solutions-company.aspx
- Elm 40 percent announcement: https://elm.sa/en/media-center/news/Pages/Elm-signs-preliminary-term-sheet-to-increase-ownership-of-Smart-National-Solutions-to-40-percent.aspx
- Elm 2025 Annual Report: https://www.elm.sa/en/investor-relations/financial-information/AnnualReports/elm%202025%20Annual%20Report%20-%20English.pdf
